author: George Uche-Umeh
approved_rule: Adoption previews a graceful stop of a running legacy VM, proves the same VM and legacy work are stopped, and restores its prior running state only after verified handoff and supported recorded startup. Already-stopped VMs stay stopped; unknown state blocks cutover and no force escalation is automatic.
internal_mechanisms: Positive same-instance quiescence; old/new guards; exact metadata backups; active-record retirement; recoverable ownership publication; separate ownership/restoration results.
